text: Compute the entropy of a biased coin and watch it collapse. Fill in the three blanks.
choices: if (___) return 0;                  // certainty (p is 0 or 1) carries none
answer: p * (1 - p) == 0|-(p * log2(p) + (1 - p) * log2(1 - p))|Math.log(x) / Math.log(2)
explanation: Verified: 1.0000, 0.4690, 0.0808, 0.0114. A coin landing heads 99.9% of the time carries about a hundredth of a bit per flip, so a thousand flips carry about 11 bits and could be sent in two bytes. The guard for p = 0 and p = 1 is necessary rather than tidy: `log(0)` is negative infinity and the product would be NaN.
